problems.original_quote: remains, to the best of our knowledge, somewhat underexplored in the existing literature
problems.revised_quote: to the best of our knowledge, whether reviewer identity affects this relationship remains underexplored
problems.explanation: Dropping the hedge "somewhat" makes the claimed research gap stronger than the authors stated.

problems.original_quote: reviewer identity has a significant effect
problems.revised_quote: reviewer identity has a significant effect on this relationship
problems.explanation: The original does not say what the effect is on; the revision makes it a moderating effect on the review–sales relationship, which is a specific claim about the finding that the original does not make.
The novelty qualifier on the dataset was dropped.

problems.original_quote: has important implications for platform design
problems.explanation: The qualifier "important" on the implications was dropped.

parsed.summary: Most edits are faithful tightening, but removing "somewhat" strengthens the research-gap claim, and adding "on this relationship" states what the effect is on when the original did not. Several minor qualifiers were also dropped.
